The ten inverse monomial pairs are distinct modulo the subgroup generated by (2,2), and multiplying their characters by 11 gives exactly the stated three swaps. Direct Frobenius on the connecting Čech representatives multiplies their eleventh powers by the tenth power of the sextic, giving the three classes of exponent vectors and the explicit polynomials. Independent replay python3 /tmp/opencode/frozen_nov24_algebra.py (sextic part) used repeated sparse multiplication rather than the frozen multinomial method; it found permutation [0,8,7,3,6,5,4,2,1,9], determinant degree 49, and ranks (0,6,10,4,9,10,9,10,10,10) at increasing smooth prime-field parameters. The repaired check_character_ranks.py also passed, verifying all character labels, the three twists, every local minor order and the four elliptic Hasse factors. The general iterate claim follows by semilinear composition, since each orbit has the same polynomial at each end of every swap. Thus each target line has cokernel R/(h_i^s_n). Its valuation is an elementary order, and a unit row/column permutation reduces every minor calculation to products of diagonal entries. In particular the first eight orders at 0 give 9s_n; this is a rank-scheme order, not an additional rank value. The one-step stable-rank equality is fiberwise and follows from each nonzero cycle staying invertible under all twists. All these computations concern the branch curve, not its double-cover K3 cohomology. The frozen script was inspected, not executed.

value.rationale: Frobenius rank records only the dimension of surviving directions. The ten marked character arrows specify which directions die, which exchange under Frobenius, and how quickly each coefficient vanishes along the natural family. For example an order-8 inference from numerical corank at the Fermat point would miss the actual order-9 eight-minor ideal before twisting, and twisted orders change while rank does not. The relative calculation is useful for comparisons of deformations and iterated rank loci in this marked pencil. It is distinct from recomputing the known elliptic product or suggesting new K3 invariants.
